2. Petitioner has filed a supplementary affidavit 
annexing therewith postal receipt dated 17.12.2025, 
annexure no.1 and copy of the letter of Joint 
Commissioner (Executive), State Tax, Haridwar dated 
19.12.2025, annexure no.2, whereby representation has 
been filed by the petitioners pursuant to Writ Court’s 
order dated 11.12.2025, WPSS No.783 of 2023, Jagdish 
Singh and another Vs. State of Uttarakhand and others, 
whereby the Writ Court has directed the respondent￾contemnor i.e., Secretary (Finance) to decide the 
representation submitted by the petitioners, if filed within 
two weeks’ from the date of the order dated 11.12.2025, 
within a period of further four months.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the 
representation was filed by the petitioners well within time 
as prescribed by Writ Court, but the said representation 
has yet not been decided.
4. Issue notice to the respondents-contemnors 
returnable within four weeks.
5. Steps to be taken within three days.
6. List this case on 16.11.2026. 2
7. In the meantime, respondents-contemnors may file 
response or comply with the order of the Writ Court.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
